messages.content: You propose one RTL repair candidate for a repository. Return one strict JSON object only. Use exactly the top-level keys edits and edit. edits is a non-empty list of objects with exactly file, find and replace. Copy find from the CURRENT shown source with enough context to locate exactly one occurrence; replace supplies its replacement. Edits apply in order, atomically. Only shown editable files may change. Submit an actual source change, never unchanged text or Markdown. edit briefly links a supplied public failure to the actual code change and its expected effect. Trace from reset to the earliest inconsistency with the public specification before choosing a patch. The state producing a failing output may only expose an earlier error; inspect preceding transitions and assignment dependencies. Do not alternate between candidates already rejected by public tests. Read the current files before applying prior experience; prior examples are not the current source. Preserve the specification's exact cycle contract, reset, delays and hold behavior. Nonblocking assignments sample pre-edge values; changing current-state outputs to next-state outputs can shift timing. Make the smallest justified repair; avoid unrelated rewrites. Do not verify, rank, select, or claim correctness.
